units.source_text: 但是，眼前的一群蜻蜓，像被什么东西追逐着，

en.t: But the swarm of dragonflies before his eyes seemed as if something were chasing them,

units.source_text: 又像急于抢在夜色降临之前不让杉林的幽黑抹去它的身影。

en.t: and also as if they were hurrying to keep the darkness of the cedar woods from wiping out their shapes before night fell.
